name: accord
description: A narrative framework for substantial human-agent work: agree on purpose, authority, review, and reserved judgment, then adapt together as evidence changes the work.

interface.shortDescription: Purpose, trust, and judgment for substantial AI work
interface.longDescription: Reach a working agreement before substantial human-agent work begins, give the agent room to own implementation, and return consequential judgment to the human while change remains practical.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Accord to reach a working agreement with me before beginning this work.
